description: LocalRouter on one Apple Silicon Mac (unified memory, Metal): chat, Drama 3 speech, KnowLine decisions, Whisper transcription and Qwen-Image, each as an out-of-process server or cmd worker (docs/dev/MAC-PORT.md). Not installable yet: each model's entry is added by its port.

prereqs.title: jq, curl, git, tar, xz, shasum, python3
prereqs.test: for t in jq curl git tar xz shasum python3; do command -v $t > /dev/null || exit 1; done

prereqs.title: an Apple Silicon Mac (arm64)
prereqs.fix: none: Intel Macs have no unified memory for these models

prereqs.title: Zig 0.17.0 (builds LocalRouter)
prereqs.fix: brew install zig (Homebrew ships 0.17.0), or the pinned archive in host.tools.zig

prereqs.title: Xcode with its licence accepted and the Metal Toolchain (xcrun metal: builds Metal kernels from source; prebuilt release archives do not need it). When xcode-select points at the Command Line Tools, builds need DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer
prereqs.fix: install Xcode; sudo xcodebuild -license accept; sudo xcodebuild -runFirstLaunch; xcodebuild -downloadComponent MetalToolchain; export DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer (or sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode.app)

prereqs.title: python3 3.11 or newer (the cmd workers and the qualification scripts)

steps.title: LocalRouter itself, from this checkout (zig build: no CUDA engines on macOS)
steps.fix: the build output says why; check zig version (0.17.0)

models.title: Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo text to image and edits of up to five images (MLX-Serve 8-bit, 8 steps; a cmd worker, loaded on demand)

licence.name: Qwen Research License: non-commercial research or evaluation only

models.skip: leave image out of --models; picture requests then fail with 'no image model'

steps.title: the MLX-Serve 26.10.3 binary, the 8-bit Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo pack (17.7 GB, every file against its pin) and the worker's Python
steps.fix: network: run again (finished files are kept, a partial one resumes). 'sha256 … pinned' or 'differs from': delete the named file and run again
